method: Scheduled Pillar Two 30-day news refresh (3 Nov 2026 HKT): WebSearch plus fetching primary official pages for OECD, HK IRD, SG IRAS/MOF/SSO, and JP NTA/MOF. Items added only when date and content were confirmed against a fetched source.
